top_news.title: Malta Tourism Authority and Trip.com Group Sign Strategic Cooperation Memorandum of Understanding to Promote Malta as a Global Destination
top_news.summary: VALLETTA, Malta, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On the sidelines of the 2026 WTTC Global Summit held in Malta, Carlo Micallef, CEO of the Malta Tourism Authority, met with Edison Chen, Vice President of Trip.com Group, for talks on China-Malta tourism cooperation. Witnessed by Jo Etienne Abela, Malta's Minister for Tourism, the Malta Tourism Authority and Trip.com Group formally signed the 2026-2029 Strategic Cooperation Memorandum of Understanding. Malta Tourism Authority and Trip.com Group sign a Strategic Cooperation Memorandum of Understanding to promote Malta as a global destination over the next three years. DOI (Malta) The signing of the Strategic Cooperation MOU marks a further deepening of the strategic partnership between the Malta Tourism Authority and Trip.com Group. Over the next three years, the two parties will carry out in-depth cooperation in destination promotion, tourism product diversification and sustainable tourism. (From left to right) Carlo Micallef, CEO of the Malta Tourism Authority, together with Jo Etienne Abela, Malta's Minister for Tourism, met with Edison Chen, Vice President of Trip.com Group, for talks on China-Malta tourism cooperation. Trip.com Group "Malta is committed to diversifying its source markets, and China is the most important emerging market in our strategic plans," said CarloMicallef, CEO of the Malta Tourism Authority. "Our partnership with Trip.com Group will help us reach high-value travellers in China and around the world more precisely, and showcase Malta's unique appeal as a premium Mediterranean tourism destination." Edison Chen, Vice President of Trip.com Group, said, "Malta is a vibrant destination, offering a wealth of cultural and premium experiences, and excellent connectivity. Our data shows a 60% growth in inbound travel bookings to Malta, underscoring its growing appeal among global travellers. By combining Trip.com Group's global reach and platform technology with Malta's unique offerings, we are excited to further boost tourism in Malta, inspiring more travellers from Asia and around the world to discover its beauty." Malta Accelerates Its Push into the Asian Market Malta is actively expanding into the Asian market, with plans to raise the share of arrivals from outside the EU to 40% within the next decade. Carlo Micallef, CEO of the Malta Tourism Authority, said that Malta is advancing tourism cooperation discussions with China and several other Asian countries. Although Schengen visa requirements remain a short-term challenge, the market potential is immense. Trip.com Group's platform coverage advantages across the world's major source markets, together with its leading big-data and AI-supported capabilities, will help Malta enhance its brand influence as a premium tourism destination. With a large presence in Asia, Europe and across global markets, Trip.com Group is highly strategically aligned with the Malta Tourism Authority's market diversification strategy. The 2026 WTTC Global Summit was held from 7 to 9 October at the Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta, bringing together tourism industry CEOs and senior government leaders from more than 100 countries. The signing is one of the significant cooperation outcomes achieved during the Summit. Over the next three years, the two parties will leverage the technological capabilities and data insights of Trip.com Group's global platforms, combined with the Malta Tourism Authority's in-depth understanding and integration of local tourism resources, to continuously optimise promotional strategies and position Malta as a highly attractive Mediterranean tourism destination for global travellers. About Trip.com Group Trip.com Group is a global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar. Across its platforms, Trip.com Group helps travellers around the world make informed and cost-effective bookings for travel products and services and enables partners to connect their offerings with users through the aggregation of travel-related content and resources, and an advanced transaction platform consisting of apps, websites and 24/7 customer service centres. Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is on the mission "to pursue the perfect trip for a better world". Find out more about Trip.com Group here: group.trip.com. Follow us on: X , Facebook , LinkedIn , and YouTube.

top_news.title: Tamil Nadu: PM Modi inaugurates Chennai Metro Phase II stretch built at Rs 4,900 crore
top_news.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday inaugurated the Poonamallee-Vadapalani stretch of Phase II of the Chennai Metro Rail Project, built at a cost of around Rs 4,900 crore. Following the inauguration, PM Modi took a ride on the Chennai Metro from Porur Bypass Station to Poonamallee Bypass Station and back. Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay was also present. Prime Minister will lay the foundation stone of and inaugurate key National Highway projects worth around Rs 3,700 crore. These projects will strengthen road connectivity, reduce travel time, ease traffic congestion and support economic growth in the State. Prime Minister will inaugurate the 36-km, four-laned Vadugapatti-Therkuvenganallur section of NH-744. The project will improve connectivity to important pilgrimage, industrial and commercial centres in the region, facilitating smoother movement of people and goods. He will also inaugurate the 30-km, four-laned Madurai Ring Road section of NH-744A. The project will improve traffic movement around Madurai and help ease congestion within the city, the release said. Prime Minister will lay the foundation stone of the four-lane Thiruvarur Bypass on the Nagapattinam-Thanjavur section of NH-83. The project will strengthen road connectivity in Thiruvarur and facilitate smoother traffic movement by providing an alternative route around the town. Prime Minister will dedicate and inaugurate railway infrastructure projects worth over Rs 750 crore. He will dedicate the Karaikal-Peralam railway line, further strengthening rail connectivity in the region. He will also dedicate three rail flyovers in Coimbatore and surrounding areas. These will ease congestion at busy level crossings, reduce waiting time and improve road safety for commuters. Prime Minister will also inaugurate five Amrit Stations at Palani, Vellore Cantonment, Ambasamudram, Paramakkudi and Namakkal, which have been redeveloped under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme, the release said. Prime Minister will inaugurate and lay the foundation stone of several port-related projects in Tamil Nadu to strengthen maritime infrastructure, expand cargo-handling capacity and improve logistics efficiency. articles.title: Malta Tourism Authority and Trip.com Group Sign Strategic Cooperation Memorandum of Understanding to Promote Malta as a Global Destination
articles.summary: VALLETTA, Malta, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On the sidelines of the 2026 WTTC Global Summit held in Malta, Carlo Micallef, CEO of the Malta Tourism Authority, met with Edison Chen, Vice President of Trip.com Group, for talks on China-Malta tourism cooperation. Witnessed by Jo Etienne Abela, Malta's Minister for Tourism, the Malta Tourism Authority and Trip.com Group formally signed the 2026-2029 Strategic Cooperation Memorandum of Understanding. Malta Tourism Authority and Trip.com Group sign a Strategic Cooperation Memorandum of Understanding to promote Malta as a global destination over the next three years. DOI (Malta) The signing of the Strategic Cooperation MOU marks a further deepening of the strategic partnership between the Malta Tourism Authority and Trip.com Group. Over the next three years, the two parties will carry out in-depth cooperation in destination promotion, tourism product diversification and sustainable tourism. (From left to right) Carlo Micallef, CEO of the Malta Tourism Authority, together with Jo Etienne Abela, Malta's Minister for Tourism, met with Edison Chen, Vice President of Trip.com Group, for talks on China-Malta tourism cooperation. Trip.com Group "Malta is committed to diversifying its source markets, and China is the most important emerging market in our strategic plans," said CarloMicallef, CEO of the Malta Tourism Authority. "Our partnership with Trip.com Group will help us reach high-value travellers in China and around the world more precisely, and showcase Malta's unique appeal as a premium Mediterranean tourism destination." Edison Chen, Vice President of Trip.com Group, said, "Malta is a vibrant destination, offering a wealth of cultural and premium experiences, and excellent connectivity. Our data shows a 60% growth in inbound travel bookings to Malta, underscoring its growing appeal among global travellers. By combining Trip.com Group's global reach and platform technology with Malta's unique offerings, we are excited to further boost tourism in Malta, inspiring more travellers from Asia and around the world to discover its beauty." Malta Accelerates Its Push into the Asian Market Malta is actively expanding into the Asian market, with plans to raise the share of arrivals from outside the EU to 40% within the next decade. Carlo Micallef, CEO of the Malta Tourism Authority, said that Malta is advancing tourism cooperation discussions with China and several other Asian countries. Although Schengen visa requirements remain a short-term challenge, the market potential is immense. Trip.com Group's platform coverage advantages across the world's major source markets, together with its leading big-data and AI-supported capabilities, will help Malta enhance its brand influence as a premium tourism destination. With a large presence in Asia, Europe and across global markets, Trip.com Group is highly strategically aligned with the Malta Tourism Authority's market diversification strategy. The 2026 WTTC Global Summit was held from 7 to 9 October at the Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta, bringing together tourism industry CEOs and senior government leaders from more than 100 countries. The signing is one of the significant cooperation outcomes achieved during the Summit. Over the next three years, the two parties will leverage the technological capabilities and data insights of Trip.com Group's global platforms, combined with the Malta Tourism Authority's in-depth understanding and integration of local tourism resources, to continuously optimise promotional strategies and position Malta as a highly attractive Mediterranean tourism destination for global travellers. About Trip.com Group Trip.com Group is a global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar. Across its platforms, Trip.com Group helps travellers around the world make informed and cost-effective bookings for travel products and services and enables partners to connect their offerings with users through the aggregation of travel-related content and resources, and an advanced transaction platform consisting of apps, websites and 24/7 customer service centres. Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is on the mission "to pursue the perfect trip for a better world". Find out more about Trip.com Group here: group.trip.com. Follow us on: X , Facebook , LinkedIn , and YouTube.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu: PM Modi inaugurates Chennai Metro Phase II stretch built at Rs 4,900 crore
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday inaugurated the Poonamallee-Vadapalani stretch of Phase II of the Chennai Metro Rail Project, built at a cost of around Rs 4,900 crore. Following the inauguration, PM Modi took a ride on the Chennai Metro from Porur Bypass Station to Poonamallee Bypass Station and back. Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay was also present. Prime Minister will lay the foundation stone of and inaugurate key National Highway projects worth around Rs 3,700 crore. These projects will strengthen road connectivity, reduce travel time, ease traffic congestion and support economic growth in the State. Prime Minister will inaugurate the 36-km, four-laned Vadugapatti-Therkuvenganallur section of NH-744. The project will improve connectivity to important pilgrimage, industrial and commercial centres in the region, facilitating smoother movement of people and goods. He will also inaugurate the 30-km, four-laned Madurai Ring Road section of NH-744A.
